videos.script: Small functions are easy to get right. This lesson is about building bigger ones out of them, without writing a new lambda each time. {{order}} Two functions can be joined in two orders. andThen runs the first, then the second. compose runs the second first. With five, add one and double gives twelve one way and eleven the other. {{preds}} Tests combine the same way, with and, or and negate, and Java stops evaluating as soon as the answer is known. {{sort}} Comparators are where this pays most. Sort by author, then by year, newest first, in one readable line. And one trap: reversed applies to everything written before it. {{pipe}} Last, a list of cleaning steps folded into one function, so adding a step is adding a line.
